First Draft of Cosmic Dawn: Eco Man

Scene 1
The Birth of Eco Man

Setting
Rainy night, Exterior, outskirts of Dovebrook

Characters
Law Enforcement Mechatron (Pre-Eco Man transformation)
Eco Man
Polluting Company Bodyguards

Script
The mechatron lies battered on the ground, surrounded by bodyguards wielding clubs.

Mechatron: Y—You dare attack an officer of the law!?
Bodyguard: Doesn't matter who you are. This is what happens when you mess with our drainage. Still want to play the hero?
Mechatron: Environmental... protection... is everyone's... responsibility.
Bodyguard: Oh, still acting tough? You'll pipe down once you're at the bottom of the Pigeon River!

The bodyguard raises his club to deliver a lethal blow.

???: Do you crave power?
Mechatron: Who's there? Who's speaking?
???: Go now. Take this manhole cover and become a hero.

The mechatron transforms into Eco Man and rises, using the manhole cover to take down every bodyguard.

Bodyguard: Who... who ARE you?
Eco Man: Me? I'm just a beat cop who happens to care about nature.

Close-up on the manhole cover as the logo on it glows with a blinding light.

...

Investor Feedback
I have ONE demand: make the logo on the manhole cover bigger. I want everyone to know Eco Man uses our brand!

Screenwriter Reply
Understood. Changing it now!
